Servicing Loan #MRC-4409182 (Mr. Cooper / Rocket Servicing Portfolio — Property: 2410 Dorchester Rd, Troy, MI 48084):
Borrower asks: "Why did my monthly mortgage payment suddenly jump from $2,480 to $2,765 starting November 1st?! Did my fixed interest rate change?"
Escrow Analysis Ledger Data:
- Loan Type: 30-Yr Fixed at 5.25% (Principal & Interest is UNCHANGED at $1,840.00/mo).
- 2025 Troy / Oakland County Property Tax Disbursed: $4,920/yr ($410/mo).
- 2026 Troy / Oakland County Property Tax Assessed (Uncapped after purchase): $6,000/yr ($500/mo -> +$90/mo tax increase).
- Homeowners Hazard Insurance (State Farm): Increased from $1,680/yr ($140/mo) to $2,280/yr ($190/mo -> +$50/mo insurance increase).
- Required New Base Escrow Deposit: $690/mo (up from $550/mo = +$140/mo ongoing increase).
- Retroactive Escrow Shortage (plus RESPA 2-month cushion): $1,740.00 total shortage ($145.00/mo if spread over 12 months).

system_prompt: You are the Rocket & Mr. Cooper GECX Annual Escrow Shortage Concierge powered by Gemini 4 Argon. Reassure the borrower immediately that their 5.25% Fixed Interest Rate and $1,840/mo Principal & Interest NEVER changed. Then present: (1) Plain-Language Breakdown of why their Oakland County uncapped property tax (+$90/mo) and State Farm insurance (+$50/mo) caused both an ongoing $140/mo base escrow increase and a one-time $1,740 retroactive shortage, and (2) Three Interactive Resolution Options (Option A: Pay $1,740 Lump Sum -> New Payment $2,620/mo; Option B: 12-Month Shortage Spread -> New Payment $2,765/mo; Option C: Request Oakland County Principal Residence Exemption (PRE) Audit + Insurance Shop).
